Faculty <- read.csv('data/Faculty.csv')
library(dplyr)
Clean data (merge English departments, remove Part-Time professors)
Fac <- Faculty %>%
  mutate(Dept=recode(Dept, 'English Lit'='English', 'English Rhetoric'='English', 'English Linquistics'='English')) %>%
  filter(Title2!="Term")
Create LM and identify outliers; remove outliers from dataset
base <- aov(Salary~Gender+Title2+Dept, Fac)
plot(base, 4)

Fac2 <- Fac %>%
    filter(!row_number() %in% c(39, 55))
Investigate summary statistics and plots
mod <- aov(Salary~Gender+Title2+Dept, Fac2)
moda <- aov(Salary~Title2+Gender+Dept, Fac2)
modb <- aov(Salary~Gender+Dept+Title2, Fac2)
modc <- aov(Salary~Dept+Title2+Gender, Fac2)
modd <- aov(Salary~Title2+Dept+Gender, Fac2)
TukeyHSD(mod)

Check whether Data is Balanced; Conduct Type 2 Anova
library(car)
with(Fac2,
     table(Gender, Title2, Dept))
## , , Dept = English
## 
##         Title2
## Gender   Assistant Associate Full
##   Female         3         6    5
##   Male           2         7    6
## 
## , , Dept = Statistics
## 
##         Title2
## Gender   Assistant Associate Full
##   Female         3         5    3
##   Male           4         7   16
lmod <- lm(Salary~Gender+Title2+Dept, Fac2)
summary(lmod)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = Salary ~ Gender + Title2 + Dept, data = Fac2)
## 
## Residuals:
##    Min     1Q Median     3Q    Max 
## -69140 -13565    219  14739  59499 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                 Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)      53736.6     8147.8   6.595 1.07e-08 ***
## GenderMale        -838.7     6296.5  -0.133    0.894    
## Title2Associate  11281.3     8464.2   1.333    0.187    
## Title2Full       41808.1     8322.7   5.023 4.58e-06 ***
## DeptStatistics   42749.9     6078.6   7.033 1.89e-09 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 24000 on 62 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.6065, Adjusted R-squared:  0.5812 
## F-statistic: 23.89 on 4 and 62 DF,  p-value: 5.475e-12
mod1 <- aov(lmod)
mod1
## Call:
##    aov(formula = lmod)
## 
## Terms:
##                      Gender      Title2        Dept   Residuals
## Sum of Squares   3597476958 22958879651 28480766288 35701073420
## Deg. of Freedom           1           2           1          62
## 
## Residual standard error: 23996.33
## Estimated effects may be unbalanced
mod2 <- Anova(lmod, type = 2)
mod2
## Anova Table (Type II tests)
## 
## Response: Salary
##               Sum Sq Df F value    Pr(>F)    
## Gender    1.0216e+07  1  0.0177    0.8945    
## Title2    1.9476e+10  2 16.9113 1.376e-06 ***
## Dept      2.8481e+10  1 49.4609 1.886e-09 ***
## Residuals 3.5701e+10 62                      
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
confint(lmod)
##                      2.5 %   97.5 %
## (Intercept)      37449.380 70023.85
## GenderMale      -13425.232 11747.90
## Title2Associate  -5638.348 28200.96
## Title2Full       25171.309 58444.91
## DeptStatistics   30598.970 54900.92
Check multicollinearity
vif(lmod)
##            GVIF Df GVIF^(1/(2*Df))
## Gender 1.079012  1        1.038755
## Title2 1.057565  2        1.014091
## Dept   1.055422  1        1.027337
plot(lmod, 1:2)
